articles.title: Bitcoin slips after rebounding from July 14 low that triggered $2 billion of liquidations
articles.snippet: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.6% since midnight UTC at around $64,300, after falling to $62,100 on Sunday, its lowest since July 14, as traders await Nvidia earnings.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Plummets as Jensen Huang Exits Nvidia
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell all the way to $68,000 overnight and hit a new three-month low. But are there reasons for hope?
